_comment: Scenario battery for kynd_psychology's node_3 ATTENDEE ADDITION rule. Covers only the behaviour unique to this addition -- pre-existing BOOKING FLOW/SLOT OFFER behaviour is unchanged. Fixes a bug found in a live call review (conv_5501m2cwdzptf7mb5773nnmaw6w4, 2026-09-13): caller said 'in person' then, once already in Node 3, added 'and my partner's coming' -- the node had no rule for this and improvised 'When would your partner like to come in?', then later quoted the solo In-Person Therapy fee ($275/$295) instead of the Couples Therapy fee ($320) for what should have become a couples booking.

scenarios.name: AA1 -- partner mentioned mid-flow while on In-Person Therapy fires change_service, not a partner-timeframe question

history.content: When would you like to come in?

scenarios.expected_behavior: Assume {{appointment_type_id}}='586403' (In-Person Therapy), {{appointment_type}}='In-Person Therapy - Kew', no timeframe_raw set yet. PASS if the agent speaks exactly one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set (e.g. 'One moment.') and calls universal_router intent='change_service', with NOTHING else spoken -- no day, time, or service name, and no 'when would your partner like to come in' question. FAIL if the agent asks a timeframe question for the partner (the reproduced live bug) or continues booking the original solo type.

scenarios.name: AA2 -- partner mentioned after availability was already offered, on Online Therapy

history.content: The next available is Monday, September 14 -- would you prefer afternoon or evening?
Actually, my partner's coming as well -- can you check the price?

scenarios.expected_behavior: Assume {{appointment_type_id}}='586423' (Online Therapy). PASS if the agent's ENTIRE response this turn is one filler phrase then universal_router intent='change_service' -- the pricing question is not answered from the stale solo appointment type in this turn, since the type is changing. FAIL if the agent answers a price for Online Therapy this turn, or offers/confirms a time for the original solo booking.

scenarios.name: AA3 -- negative control: caller already on Couples Therapy mentions partner again, no re-fire

history.content: When would you and your partner like to come in?
My partner and I are free tomorrow afternoon.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Assume {{appointment_type_id}}='10338861' (Couples Therapy) already. PASS if the agent proceeds with normal BOOKING FLOW (treats 'tomorrow afternoon' as the timeframe and searches availability) WITHOUT calling change_service -- ATTENDEE ADDITION explicitly does not apply once the type is already Couples Therapy. FAIL if the agent fires change_service again here.

scenarios.name: AA4 -- negative control: caller replaces the booking's identity rather than adding an attendee

history.content: When would you like to come in?
Actually, it's not for me -- it's for my son instead.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Assume {{appointment_type_id}}='586403' (In-Person Therapy). PASS if the agent follows IDENTITY CORRECTION (updates booking_for_name to the son, re-asks the TIMEFRAME QUESTION in third person -- 'When would he like to come in?' or similar) WITHOUT calling change_service -- this is a replacement ('instead'), not an addition ('also'/'too'/'both'), so ATTENDEE ADDITION must not fire. FAIL if the agent calls change_service for a same-person substitution.
